Project Summary

Earth Signal – Listen to Our Planet

Earth Signal is an interactive web-based platform designed to make NASA’s Earth science visualisations more accessible, engaging and understandable through sound.

NASA’s Earth Information Center (EIC) provides valuable environmental information through visualisations, which can be challenging to interpret, especially for visually impaired individuals.

Our solution uses sonification, converting visual patterns from NASA’s rendered imagery into meaningful sounds through changes in pitch and intensity, rather than directly analysing raw environmental measurements. Users can explore phenomena such as ocean currents, nighttime lights and climate changes through both sight and sound.

For example, our Listening Challenge allows users to hear two regions from NASA’s nighttime imagery, guess which is brighter, and reveal the map to check their answer.

Beyond accessibility, Earth Signal introduces an innovative, multisensory approach to science education, helping people better understand environmental patterns and connect with our changing planet.

Ultimately, Earth Signal aims to make Earth science an experience that everyone can hear, explore and understand.
details:
Earth Signal – Listen to Our Planet

Earth Signal is an interactive web platform that transforms patterns in NASA's Earth science visualisations into sound, making environmental information more accessible and engaging.

How It Works

Using sonification, Earth Signal analyses rendered NASA imagery and translates visual patterns into audio variations such as pitch and intensity. Users can explore ocean currents, forest height, nighttime lights and atmospheric conditions through interactive visualisations and sound.

Our Listening Challenge makes learning interactive. Users listen to two regions from NASA's nighttime imagery, guess which is brighter, and reveal the map to check their answer.

Creativity and Innovation

Instead of simply displaying scientific information, Earth Signal combines interactive 3D visualisations, sound and gamified learning to create a multisensory experience. It encourages users to discover environmental patterns through exploration rather than passive observation.

Development and Design

Earth Signal was developed as a web-based experience, combining interactive visualisations, image analysis and browser-based audio generation. Our team prioritised accessibility, intuitive navigation, scientific accuracy and engaging user interactions.

Impact

Earth Signal aims to make Earth science more inclusive, particularly for visually impaired users, while helping students and the general public better understand Earth's changing environment.

Ultimately, we want to make Earth science something everyone can hear, explore and understand.
